findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: ul.absolute.top-[54px] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (PingFang SC, Alimama ShuHeiTi, -apple-system).
Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: PingFang SC
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
